# betterado_release_definition_history (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve the full revision history of an Azure DevOps
classic release definition. Each entry represents a saved revision with a
timestamp and the identity of the user who made the change.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `release_definition_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revisions` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--revisions))
